show.columnsBody: Show any value of the process beside each record: a field, a remembered or worked-out value, or a column of the row a field links to. Up to {{max}}, for everyone.
show.none: This process has no values to show yet.
show.holes: You can name the record's values in this text: {{a}} for a field, {{b}} for a column of the row it links to.
show.holesMsg: For process messages you can also use {{a}} and {{b}} — values of the record and of the rows it links to.
